description: Mark the household away from home (a trip, the cabin) from date to endDate. Planned dinners on unlocked days in the span are taken off the plan.

date.description: First day away, ISO date. A trip lies ahead: take a bare weekday from the context line's 'nearest weekday ahead' field, never from a day marked '(past)'.

endDate.description: Last day away, ISO date; omit for a single day. Never earlier than 'date' — a span runs forwards from its first day.

name: mark_away
title: Mark away from home
